issue_body:
# Performance regression: `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` — third consecutive audit below 85

## Summary
The Screenshot → PrimeVue project page has scored below the 85 performance threshold for **three consecutive nightly audits** and shows no meaningful improvement.

| Date | Perf | LCP (ms) | TBT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-11 | 78 | 4784 | 55 |
| 2026-08-12 | 77 | 4618 | 189 |
| 2026-08-13 | 78 | 4526 | 194 |

All other scores (accessibility, best practices, SEO) remain 100.

## Root cause (likely)
- The three sample thumbnail images (Login form, Analytics dashboard, Pricing page) are served at full resolution and likely in PNG/JPEG format — converting to WebP at display size (~300 px wide) would be the single largest win.
- Below-fold thumbnails have no `loading="lazy"` attribute, blocking LCP.
- The drop-zone icon is likely render-blocking; inlining or preloading it would reduce LCP.

## Recommended fixes
1. Convert sample thumbnails to WebP at ~300 px wide and serve via `<picture>` or `srcset`.
2. Add `loading="lazy"` to the two below-fold thumbnail images.
3. Preload or inline the drop-zone SVG/icon so it doesn't delay the critical path.
4. Verify no large unused JS bundles are loaded on this page (TBT is consistently ~190 ms).

## Acceptance criteria
- Lighthouse performance ≥ 85 on next nightly audit.
- LCP ≤ 3 500 ms.
